sharedSpec: 480 GSM brushed fleece, relaxed cut, kangaroo pocket, ribbed cuffs and hem, small SL monogram embroidered on the left chest. Sizes S/M/L/XL.

designs.name: Aubergine Geoband
designs.description: The signature. Deep aubergine cut with a geometric cloudy-and-cement band across the chest, striped hem and cuffs, SL in pale blue.

designs.name: Glacier Snowflake
designs.description: Snow white with one huge tonal snowflake blown across the chest and shoulders. Quiet from far away, detailed up close.

designs.name: Midnight Slash
designs.description: Midnight navy slashed diagonally with ice blue and stone grey, the colour-block running straight through the pocket.

designs.name: Pine Peaks
designs.description: Deep pine green with a white line-art range of peaks and forest across the chest. For people who would rather be in the mountains.

designs.name: Charcoal Circuit
designs.description: Charcoal grey with twin cement-and-white racing stripes running shoulder to cuff. The sportiest cut in the drop.

designs.name: Blush Fade
designs.description: A slow ombre melt from deep rose at the shoulders to near-white at the hem, like sunrise on fresh snow. SL stitched in deep aubergine.

designs.name: Ember Sleeves
designs.description: Matte black body, fire up both arms. Ember-orange flames climb from the cuffs and the hood is lined in burnt orange.

designs.name: Aurora Speckle
designs.description: Pale ice blue caught in a snow shower: an all-over speckle of white flakes woven through the whole garment. SL in deep aubergine.

designs.name: Cream Retro Peaks
designs.description: Warm cream with a vintage-wash 70s sunset over layered peaks in rust, amber and olive. Old soul, new fleece.

designs.name: Frost Camo
designs.description: Camouflage rewritten for winter: ice crystals and frost ferns in white and silver over heather grey.

designs.name: Cloudy Swirl
designs.description: Cloudy blue and white swirled like a winter sky. The dye moves differently on every piece, so no two are exactly alike.

designs.name: Cement Patchwork
designs.description: Hand-finished patchwork of cement greys, charcoal and stone with a single aubergine block down one side. SL in cloudy blue.

heroProduct.name: Aubergine Prime
heroProduct.description: The hero piece. Plain deep aubergine, cloudy-blue SL embroidery, cut oversized.
